title: Implement grammar parser and serializer

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 compact candidate-output grammar parser and deterministic serializer selection only
scope.implementation_delta: The current residual-intelligence authority already provides the smallest complete delta: closed versioned grammars, strict parsing, typed output construction, and deterministic dictionary serialization with content-derived CIDs. The declared output authority permits no source change. Creating a parallel PCSM parser or serializer would duplicate this authority and violate the task boundary.

selected_existing_authority.parser_contract: decode_structured_output accepts only bounded UTF-8 str or bytes, parses one JSON object with duplicate-key rejection, rejects unknown or missing outer/payload fields and invalid typed/bounded values, then returns valid typed candidate output or invalid_output without prose recovery.
selected_existing_authority.serializer_contract: ExpertGrammar.to_dict emits sorted field-contract mappings; StructuredDecodeResult.to_dict and ResidualTaskOutput.to_dict emit explicit schema-bearing primitive dictionaries. Their grammar/result/output IDs are content-derived through canonical_id over the identity form without its derived ID.
selected_existing_authority.version_and_cid_binding: The grammar, field-contract, decode-result, and candidate schemas are explicit @1 strings. Every grammar has a content-derived grammar_id; consumers must recompute IDs from the bound typed representations rather than trust model text or aliases.

grammar_catalog.catalog_identity_rule: Consumers must recompute the entire sorted typed catalog digest and every grammar_id from the bound source, then reject any schema, count, digest, or ID mismatch. Anchor IDs do not replace full-catalog recomputation.

selected_existing_authority.authority_boundary: ResidualTaskOutput requires candidate_only=true. Its grammar, parsed/serialized output, model response, and this receipt grant neither mutation, proof acceptance, promotion, validation acceptance, nor task completion. Independent supervisor authorities remain required.
selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: This current-head equivalent is deterministic, versioned, schema/CID-bound where applicable, closed, byte-bounded, duplicate-key-rejecting, typed, and directly covered by positive and negative tests. A PCSM-specific parallel parser or serializer would be an unnecessary competing authority.

limitations: The selected parser and serializer handle compact candidate outputs for current residual task families; they are not an authorization or mutation protocol.
Schema, catalog, grammar, result, and output identity are source-bound. Consumers must reject changed bound source identities and obtain a fresh receipt.
Only the declared receipt was changed. No parallel PCSM parser/serializer was created because the existing authority satisfies the task's Python v1 scope.
This receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
